narrative.summary: BioGraph Steward builds scoped Pharos/CIViC graphs with cited answers and auditable exports. Four eligible development records pass source fidelity. Agent reliability, intended-user usability and biological improvement remain unproven.
accomplishments: Completed the guided workbench, review and graph-plus-decision exports. Verified an isolated build, installation and synthetic replay with declared dependencies. Tested, MIT-licensed code includes Docker/Brev configuration.

The NVIDIA model’s experimental tool interface matched 3/4 supported development requests, versus 1/4 previously, but incorrectly accepted 2/8 unsupported requests. It remains experimental. The app checks explicit selections and requires review before construction.

Verified official IntAct XML provenance on consumed studies. Corresponding checked fields agree; XML exposes a three-participant interaction behind two tabular rows. Four eligible protein records span only two pairs/two publications, all positive co-immunoprecipitation observations.
A matched comparison of 1,751 measured protein pairs found no consistent prediction gain from adding Gene Ontology hierarchy to the restricted Pharos graph across three seeds.

Integrated published assay records for 3,222 nominated pairs, preserving detections, nondetections and exclusions. Assisted feedback prompted clearer assay explanations; improved user comprehension remains unmeasured.
blockers: Biological value remains the main open question: we cannot yet show that added evidence improves scientific decisions. Shared-study provenance and reserved pair overlap remain unresolved. Reserved assessment awaits fixed audit and execution rules.
Agent proposals can omit requested conditions; arbitrary questions remain unreliable. The assisted source/export walkthrough is incomplete, and intended-user task success is unmeasured.

Organizer clarification needed: baseline/version, comparison scope, formats/identifiers, and treatment of undecided edges and uncalibrated confidence. Hidden test answers are unnecessary for preparation. Brev compute and AWS credits are available.
milestones: Complete the development provenance audit using recorded XML context. Freeze final execution and exclusion rules before reserved access. Finish the assisted source/export walkthrough.

Complete bounded source-fidelity assessment where reference suitability permits. Extend controlled pruning/update checks, measuring erroneous removals and preserving uncertainty. Resolve export constraints and evaluate intended-user tasks.

Publish code, source/license manifests and evaluation artifacts. Have another person replay the real-data demonstration; prepare final deployment and demo. Use AWS for a concrete need. Report preservation and biological benefit separately.
